subject: 2025 regular-season overtime change

values.value: Both teams get a possession opportunity, subject to a 10-minute period

evidence_line: NFL teams adopted to align the postseason and regular season overtime rules by granting both teams an opportunity to possess the ball regardless of the outcome of the first possession, subject to a 10-minute overtime period in the regular season.

subject: NFL Game Book

values.value: PDF containing every score and stat from the game

evidence_line: At the bottom of the Recap, there should be a Download Game Book PDF containing every score and stat from the game.

subject: GSIS statistical corrections

values.value: Corrections made with Elias Sports Bureau

evidence_line: Corrections to existing game information will be made regularly in conjunction with Elias Sports Bureau, the official statistician of the NFL.

subject: NFL widget odds providers
evidence_line: Odds are provided by the official sportsbook partners of the NFL: FanDuel, Caesars, and DraftKings.

subject: NFL Support total definition
evidence_line: A total is a bet on the number of points scored in the game by both teams combined, including overtime.

subject: NFL Support moneyline example

values.value: Tie returns the stake in this example

evidence_line: If the game ends in a tie, the bettor's wager is returned with no loss or profit.

subject: Completion Probability inputs

values.value: Air distance, air yards, receiver/defender separation, pass-rusher distance, QB speed, and other tracking inputs

evidence_line: Those inputs include pass air distance (from quarterback to receiver), air yards, the distance between the receiver and the nearest defender, the distance between the quarterback and the nearest pass rusher, the speed of the quarterback at throw, among several other metrics.

subject: FanDuel NFL player-prop participation

values.value: Active and at least one snap; otherwise applicable props void

evidence_line: NFL player props are settled as normal if the player is active and plays at least one snap. If the player is inactive, or active but does not play a snap, applicable player prop bets are void.

subject: FanDuel touchdown scorer

values.value: A passing touchdown does not make the passer a touchdown scorer

evidence_line: A player who throws a touchdown pass is NOT considered the touchdown scorer.

subject: FanDuel two-point conversion statistics

values.value: Yards and receptions on a two-point attempt excluded from standard totals

evidence_line: Yards and receptions recorded during a two-point attempt do not count toward standard yardage or reception totals.
